message.content: The pain in my upper back started about two days ago, and over the next day or so the weakness in both legs got worse until I couldn’t stand at all, and then I began losing control of my bladder and bowels. I haven’t had any fever, recent infections, injuries, cancer, clotting problems, or been taking blood thinners.
